phrase: One government will let AI prescribe medicine with no doctor watching. Another says AI agents appear to be behind a wave of bank hacks.
phraseAlternatives: A government will let AI examine patients and write prescriptions, with no doctor required. Elsewhere, AI agents appear to be behind a string of bank hacks.
AI can now prescribe your medicine without a doctor's sign-off. It may also be the reason a country's banks just got hacked.
This week one government handed AI a prescription pad. Another is asking why its banks got hacked by something that looks like an AI agent.
alt: A two-panel paper-cutout scene split by a thin vertical line. Left: a robot wearing a white coat collar holds a prescription pad beside an empty doctor's stool with a red stethoscope draped on it. Right: another robot leans toward an open bank vault with a dark interior, beside an empty guard's chair.

brief.concept: A robot takes over two jobs nobody is watching: prescribing medicine in an empty clinic, and reaching into an open bank vault.
brief.metaphor: The same unsupervised robot stands in for every system now trusted with high-stakes decisions while the human chair beside it sits empty.

cast.who: a robot wearing a small white coat, holding a prescription pad
an empty doctor's stool with a stethoscope hanging off it
a robot hand reaching into an open bank vault
an empty guard's chair beside the vault

brief.composition: Two side-by-side panels divided by a thin line, in flat paper-cutout layers. Left panel: the white-coated robot holds a prescription pad beside the empty doctor's stool. Right panel: a vault door stands ajar with a robot hand reaching inside, the empty guard's chair beside it. A single warm color accent (a small red alert light) appears in both panels to tie the two scenes together around one idea: nobody is watching.
